listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference citation to a study of the pulp and paper industry (a continuous primary-processing sector), used only as a bibliographic source on energy-efficiency barriers/drivers
listed_sector_signals.quote:
P. Thollander and M. Ottosson, “An energy efficient Swedish pulp and paper industry – 
exploring barriers to and driving forces for cost-effective energy efficiency investments,”

one_line: The paper develops and applies an Energy Management Maturity Model (EM3) in a case study at Boston Scientific Corporation, a multi-site life-sciences (medical device) discrete manufacturing organisation, not a continuous-flow production context.
